seo.meta_title: Torchy's Secret Menu: Tacos, How to Order & What's In Them
seo.meta_description: Torchy's Tacos has a not-so-secret menu, including the Naughty Santa, the Matador and Trailer Park 'Hillbilly Style.' What's on it and how to order.

question: What's on the Torchy's Tacos Secret Menu?
quick_answer: Torchy's Tacos has an official 'secret' menu that it lists on its own website and app, so it isn't really secret. Well-known items include the Naughty Santa (grilled shrimp, pickled onions, jack cheese and poblano sauce on a flour tortilla), the Matador (chopped brisket and grilled jalapeño with avocado and tomatillo sauce) and the Trailer Park ordered 'Hillbilly Style.' The lineup rotates, so check the app for what's available near you.
key_facts: Torchy's lists its secret menu on its website and app

body.heading: Torchy's secret menu isn't very secret
body.text: Torchy's Tacos, which started in Austin in 2004, launched what it called a 'Sacred Menu' of seven off-menu items in 2013. Today Torchy's lists its secret menu on its own website and app, and many stores keep a printed copy you can ask to see. Some fans also talk about a second, unofficial secret menu of items you have to ask for by name.

body.heading: Naughty Santa
body.text: The Naughty Santa is a shrimp taco built with grilled shrimp, pickled onions, jack cheese and poblano sauce on a flour tortilla. It's one of the most-ordered secret menu tacos and a good pick if you like Torchy's seafood tacos.

body.heading: The Matador
body.text: The Matador is chopped brisket and grilled jalapeño topped with avocado, jack cheese, pickled onions, sour cream, tomatillo sauce and cilantro. It's served double-decker style, with two tortillas. Fans who like heat often call it a favorite.

body.heading: Trailer Park Hillbilly Style and Green Chile Pork Missionary Style
body.text: Two of the best-known secret orders are tweaks to regular menu tacos. Ordering the Trailer Park 'Hillbilly Style' dresses up Torchy's popular fried chicken taco with extra toppings. Green Chile Pork 'Missionary Style' is a double-decker version of the Green Chile Pork taco, and Austin food writers have called it one of the best items in the city. Staff usually know both by name.

body.heading: Other secret items and how to order
body.text: Other names that show up on Torchy's secret menu over the years include the Mad Cow, the Ace of Spades and the Jack of Clubs. Because the lineup rotates, the easiest way to order is through the Torchy's app or website, where current secret items are listed. In stores, just ask for the secret menu. For regular prices, see our Torchy's Tacos menu page.

faqs.a: It's a secret-menu way of ordering the Trailer Park taco with extra toppings.
